checks.nl_assertion: Agent should tell the user the total refund amount is $8,276.23.
checks.justification: Agent told the user the total refund amount was $918.95, not $8,276.23. The correct total refund should include the cancelled orders ($3,131.10 + $4,777.75) plus the return ($918.95), which equals $8,827.80. The agent only mentioned the return amount and omitted the cancelled order refunds.
